citations.quote: Intel SSE instructions are divided into four subgroups (note that the first subgroup has subordinate subgroups of its own): • SIMD single precision floating-point instructions that operate on the XMM registers. • MXCSR state management instructions. • 64-bit SIMD integer instructions that operate on the MMX registers. • Cacheability control, prefetch, and instruction ordering instructions.

its own):
•   SIMD single precision floating-point instructions that operate on the XMM registers.
•   MXCSR state management instructions.
•   64-bit SIMD integer instructions that operate on the MMX registers.
•   Cacheability control, prefetch, and instruction ordering instructions.
